cohort: The study included 86 symptomatic women who had undergone endometriosis surgery between March 2017 and March 2019 in governmental hospitals in Shiraz, Iran.
finding: The study found that dysmenorrhea responded well to medical treatment after surgery in the presence of tissue estrogen receptors > 60%, and dyspareunia responded well in the presence of tissue progesterone receptors > 80%.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between March 2017 and March 2019.
